headline: First close on the books: MCP daniel. It counts when the cash is logged, and the cash is not logged.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Finish the paperwork on the win: Daniel's row needs Deal Value, Date Closed, and the payment in the Payments tab the day it lands. Then log the outcome of mrplusmoney's call from yesterday, showed or not. Yesterday also has no EOD row. Queue after that: jeremy, Paul and cblez lead 11 untagged replies.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Cash. Still EUR 0 with 20 days left; Daniel's payment is the month's first euros the moment it hits the Payments tab. Funnel note: booking 18.8 percent, show 66.7, close 1 of 2 shown, all on samples below the gates, so no verdicts yet, just direction, and the direction is right.
